mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_name AS accountName, a.client_id AS clientId, c.name AS clientName, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version, a.closed_at AS closedAt FROM account a JOIN client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id WHERE a.account_id = #{id}
